generation_fact: One atomic relation established by a concrete execution: source information, realized transformation, concrete occurrence, formed outcome, and relation role.
generation_occurrence: One concrete execution; an occurrence can establish several distinct generation facts.
atomic_generation_fact: Each source, transformation, occurrence, outcome, and role tuple remains a separate atomic fact even when one occurrence establishes several facts.
realizes_fact: Connects an occurrence node to a generation fact that the occurrence established.
reads_from: Records an actual data dependency; declared execution order is not a substitute.
GeneratedOrigin: Allows an outcome formed earlier to participate as a source in a later generation fact.
program_order: Records declared execution order but does not by itself establish data dependency or concurrency.
equal_values: Equal numeric values or equal outputs do not identify the same fact, occurrence, result, or formation.
cartesian_recombination: Facts from one occurrence must not be split into source and result sets and recombined by Cartesian product.
missing_relations: A missing relation can mean it was not established and does not automatically prove it false; absence of a concurrency edge does not prove concurrency.
forward_query: Follow exact identities from training sample to batch occurrence, forward occurrence, loss, backward occurrence, gradient, optimizer occurrence, and new parameter version.
reverse_query: From an evaluation or parameter result, follow actual reads_from, GeneratedOrigin, realizes_fact, and incidence relations; timestamp proximity and numeric similarity are not substitutes.
